key.name: config-path
key.description: The file whose layers and comment labels are shown in the panel.

key.name: ignored-layers
key.description: Layers that never show the panel.

key.name: max-rows
key.description: Number of items per column before wrapping to a new column.

key.name: bottom-margin
key.description: Distance in pixels between the panel and the bottom of the primary monitor.

key.name: hide-timeout
key.description: Seconds after which the panel hides even if no layer release event arrived.
